tsin_finance_annex_abort_effect = {
 # The recipient has not received our cash/accounts. Restore escrow and loan roles.
 scope:tsin_annex_target ?= {

 }

 }
 }
 }

tsin_finance_annex_recover_effect = {
 save_scope_as = tsin_succession_coordinator
 every_in_global_list = { variable = tsin_annex_pending add_to_list = tsin_annex_recovery }
 every_in_list = { list = tsin_annex_recovery
 save_scope_as = tsin_annex_target
 scope:tsin_succession_coordinator = {
 if = { limit = { scope:tsin_annex_target ?= { num_locations > 0 }
 tsin_contract_calendar_month > "global_variable_map(tsin_succession_prepared_month|scope:tsin_annex_target)" }
 tsin_finance_annex_abort_effect = yes
 }
 else_if = { limit = { scope:tsin_annex_target ?= { num_locations = 0 }
 tsin_contract_calendar_month > "global_variable_map(tsin_succession_prepared_month|scope:tsin_annex_target)"
 "global_variable_map(tsin_succession_recipient|scope:tsin_annex_target)" ?= { num_locations > 0 } }
  "global_variable_map(tsin_succession_recipient|scope:tsin_annex_target)" = { save_scope_as = tsin_annex_recipient tsin_finance_annex_commit_effect = yes }
 }
 }
 }
